scoring.notes: These are provisional evidence-quality gates, NOT correct/incorrect thresholds. Full non-special multilingual vocabulary is the competitor inventory. CTC spikes are sparse, so one retained frame is allowed but reported. No calibration or training.

Prefer 2-5 seconds, report actual counts/coverage and shortfalls. Only annotation/ is manual ground truth, never textgrid/. No corpus or real results bundled.
